post.description: Authenticated dispatch with strict parameters and uncached entry/activity/sleep checks. Connected commands: bank_deposit/bank_withdraw with required signed 64-bit integer amount call Deposit/Withdraw; adventure_start with required string stage_id calls StartStage; rescue_request with required string reason calls EmergencyRescue, including during sleep/cooldown and unfinished work; home_sleep with optional target_home_id calls Sleep; home_wake with no inputs calls Wake. Home sleep is free and accepts dead/fatigued actors under existing service rules; omitted/empty target_home_id retains the actor's own-home default, while a different target is a destination only. Ordinary entry/navigation commands are blocked by actual activity, sleep and pending recovery. Continuation eligibility uses verified activity kind, role and phase; verified leave/recovery may remain eligible in conflict without generic entry gates. Early Wake reaches the service and returns HOME_STILL_SLEEPING without recovering; concurrent Wake returns HOME_WAKE_IN_PROGRESS; elapsed duration still requires explicit Wake to run recovery hooks, restore HP/MP/fatigue and clear recovery. If a mandatory recovery hook or timer cleanup fails, Wake returns EXECUTION_FAILED without clearing pending recovery. GET offers Wake only when ready; awake Wake remains ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Empty stage_id retains the starter-stage default; empty/blank reason is rejected by Rescue. Other catalog IDs return 501 until connected. Known success/rejection refreshes the shared context; unexpected execution failure returns no context and does not guarantee rollback or safe replay. No idempotency guarantee. Never automatically replay POST to recover a failed observation. Navigation commands scene_enter/scene_select/scene_page/scene_back replace one owned selection record with a seven-day TTL, without gameplay effects. Back clears a subject first, otherwise selects the registered parent. Missing/expired selection defaults to town. Selected product availability uses the existing Shop catalog. Refresh uses the same typed scene composer as GET: actual activity/conflict overrides saved selection, otherwise Home and Shop details use ordinary selection. Required activity-read failures preserve an already known command outcome with CONTEXT_REFRESH_FAILED. Party/PvP/GvG/Dungeon/Challenge/Casino continuation commands and Shop mutations remain unconnected. Depot expansion command depot_expand calls the existing Expand service once with the owned actor and request context. Selected Depot context quotes the next expansion cost or null at the purchased cap; quotes do not reserve a tier. Service-owned funds/cap validation returns DEPOT_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS or DEPOT_MAX_EXPANDED (400); invalid actor IDs return DEPOT_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID (400), and character absence returns CHARACTER_NOT_FOUND (404). Success reuses the Depot response; known success/rejection survives refresh failure with GET-only recovery. All nine Depot REST operations remain registered.

requestBody.description: One JSON document, at most 64 KiB; Content-Type must be application/json. adventure_start params accepts only required non-null string stage_id; rescue_request accepts only required non-null string reason. home_sleep accepts only optional string target_home_id; home_wake accepts no fields. Home commands accept omitted params or an empty object. Actor identity comes from the owned path; target_home_id never overrides it. bank_deposit/bank_withdraw accept only required non-null integer amount (int64); missing/null/wrong-type/out-of-range inputs are rejected before execution, while typed nonpositive or excessive values reach Bank service validation. Navigation params are strict: scene_enter requires a registered destination; scene_select requires the registered target_kind and an available target_id. scene_page requires matching destination and exactly one of offset 0..1000000 or cursor, with optional limit 1..100 (default 20), only on a pageable list with no selected subject. Only Home inbox/outbox accept cursors; Town and Shops are offset-only. scene_back accepts omitted params or an empty object. Null fields and arbitrary targets are rejected. depot_expand accepts omitted params or an empty object only: no actor, target, count or cost fields. Shared strict decoding and entry/activity/recovery guards apply.

200.description: Known command success; adventure_start result contains id, character_id, stage_id, started_at, floors_cleared, is_cleared, party_size, resolved and experience_reward, as on POST /adventures. rescue_request returns the existing RescueRecord: id, character_id, reason, penalty_seconds, created_at, including idle/no-op results. home_sleep result reuses the REST sleep response: sleeping, duration_seconds, remaining_seconds, home_character_id, message. home_wake result reuses the REST wake response: success, message, character. Refresh failure preserves success/result with null context and CONTEXT_REFRESH_FAILED. Bank results preserve character_id, money, deposit, amount and message as on REST; withdrawal also returns actual_withdrawn and refunded for wallet overflow returned to savings. Navigation result uses NavigationSelection; refreshed typed scene reports selection_unavailable without substituting a fallback.

400.description: Malformed outer JSON uses the existing transport error. Invalid typed params return INVALID_ACTION_PARAMS without execution/context. Rescue service invalid actor ID returns RESCUE_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID with refreshed context when possible. Bank service rejections use BANK_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID, BANK_INVALID_AMOUNT, BANK_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, BANK_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE and BANK_DEPOSIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; known rejections retain their code if refresh fails. Invalid navigation scene/subject/page returns INVALID_SELECTION with refresh; malformed typed inputs return INVALID_ACTION_PARAMS.

401.description: Missing or invalid session; no context.

403.description: Authentication/ownership rejection exposes no context. Adventure service rejects level/job-level requirements with ADVENTURE_LEVEL_REQUIRED / ADVENTURE_JOB_LEVEL_REQUIRED and refreshes when possible.

404.description: Unknown ActionID: ACTION_NOT_FOUND. Missing character uses transport error; Adventure/Rescue/Home/Bank service character-not-found returns CHARACTER_NOT_FOUND. Home rejects missing/expired destination houses with HOME_HOUSE_NOT_FOUND / HOME_HOUSE_EXPIRED. Known service rejections refresh context when possible. An absent or unavailable product returns SELECTION_NOT_FOUND.

409.description: Current entry or Sleep/CanWake exclusion: ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Home service rejections: HOME_ALREADY_SLEEPING, HOME_STILL_SLEEPING (early Wake does not restore vitality), HOME_NOT_SLEEPING, HOME_WAKE_IN_PROGRESS. Preserves the recognized rejection and refreshes context when possible.

415.description: Content-Type must be application/json; no execution/context.

422.description: Adventure service rejections: ADVENTURE_STAGE_NOT_FOUND, ADVENTURE_UNCONSCIOUS, ADVENTURE_EXHAUSTED, ADVENTURE_DAILY_LIMIT. Rescue rejects empty/blank reason with RESCUE_INVALID_REASON. Preserves the mapped code and refreshes when possible; current catalog exclusion instead returns 409 ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.

500.description: Authorization read failure uses transport error. ACTION_PREFLIGHT_FAILED stops execution on state-read failure. EXECUTION_FAILED leaves mutation outcome unknown; neither failure returns context.

501.description: Known unconnected ID or unconfigured dependency: ACTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no execution/context.

get.description: After ownership verification, reads current Sleep, Pending/Processing work and public Party/PvP/GvG/Dungeon/Challenge/Casino services. Actual activity overrides ordinary saved selection; explicit matching party/run links represent one activity, while contradictory exclusive facts produce activity_conflict with every fact and only verified leave/recovery controls. Completed/Failed scheduled records do not block entry; expired Pending/Processing records still do. Persisted terminal run buffers remain visible until native cleanup, without GET settlement. Required feature reads fail the whole observation. Activity data is a whitelist of kind, ID, role, phase, round, eligible action IDs and optional parent party ID. Continuation support uses mode and connected independently of entry_eligible; unconnected controls are absent from available_actions. Observation never wakes, settles, advances or replays gameplay. Shares selected-scene composition with post-command refresh. Observes ordinary navigation without writes or TTL renewal. Expired selection is town; disappeared subjects use selection_unavailable. Home and the four ordinary Shops provide typed details; Bank provides controls. Shop catalogs use existing GetCatalog eligibility/prices and offset-only pages (default 20, max 100); product detail supplies explicit purchase IDs and quantity bounds 1..9999. Observation/selection never purchases or invokes random talk. Shop purchase commands remain unconnected. Required adapter/catalog/helper/inspect reads and price errors fail the whole observation. Offered connected commands include strict params_schema and explicit params_template values.
